identity.name: Gutter Cat Gang
identity.notes: Original 3,000 Gutter Cat collection identity. Newer migrations/releases must not silently replace this historical launch identity. Historical partner evidence proves Gutter characters entered a rigged 3D avatar pipeline, and a 2025 secondary report names GLB/FBX for a newer completed Cat asset set, but current first-party delivery/access evidence has not yet been recovered.

evidence.note: Current Etherscan token profile exposes the project's Discord alongside its official website and X account.
Current Etherscan token profile exposes the official X link.
Current project history states the Gutter Cat Gang was born in June 2021.
Independent historical source resolves the original collection launch to June 8, 2021.

ip_rights.summary: Current Gutter Cat Labs terms grant the holder a worldwide royalty-free personal license and an unlimited worldwide commercial license to create derivative works from the purchased Gutter NFT, subject to the current terms and separate treatment for third-party Licensed NFTs.

evidence.note: Sections 1.3 and 1.4 define personal and unlimited commercial use; section 1.2 separates third-party Licensed NFTs.

historical_avatar_development.summary: House of Kibaa/Looking Glass Labs, the project partner retained for the Gutter metaverse work, publicly stated in 2021-2022 that it was creating metaverse-ready Gutter assets and specifically designing, modeling and rigging Gutter Cat Gang characters for avatar-system integration. Later corporate material described Gutter Cat Gang among HoK third-party client avatars that its metaverse was designed to integrate. This proves real rigged-avatar development existed, but does not by itself prove a surviving downloadable file lane or supported file format.

evidence.note: Looking Glass Labs states HoK was creating metaverse-ready 3D Gutter assets and quotes GCG leadership describing the 3D project.
Looking Glass Labs explicitly says its technology was being used to design, model and rig Gutter Cat Gang characters for integration into a 3D metaverse.
Looking Glass Labs later lists Gutter Cat Gang among third-party client avatars intended for integration into HoK's Pocket Dimension.

avatar_format_leads.note: A July 2025 Bored Ape Gazette report quotes a Gutter Cat Gang team member saying completed DashBo-designed Cat assets would be downloadable as GLB, MML and FBX through a portal then under construction. This is a high-value lead, not sufficient first-party proof of current delivery. The current official GCG site does not expose that portal in the public navigation observed in August 2026.

evidence.note: Report quotes GCG team member Ceres naming GLB, MML and FBX for finished 3D Cat assets and saying a download portal was being built.
Current public site navigation exposes shop, collection and about surfaces but no discoverable 3D asset portal.

avatar_inventory.note: Do not promote Gutter Cat Gang to the supported avatar inventory yet. Rigging is historically proven, and GLB/FBX delivery was reported in 2025, but no current first-party download surface, direct asset URLs, or exhaustive supported-format inventory has been recovered. Current project terms also state that the present ownership does not assume promises or obligations made by prior teams, so historical roadmap promises cannot substitute for current delivery evidence.

evidence.note: Current owners expressly disclaim promises, warranties and obligations made by previous owners or teams.
Historical rigging work is directly evidenced, but format and surviving delivery are not.

project_status.note: The current project site and post-2024 Gutter Cat Labs terms remain active. Current management explicitly describes itself as the third owner of the Gutter Cat Gang IP, so historical promises must be evaluated against the current terms rather than assumed to carry forward.
